about.name: qualitativeresearch
about.title: Qualitative Research
about.description: A community for qualitative researchers to share methods, tools, dilemmas, and resources. Primarily for academics and practitioners doing interview-based or ethnographic research.

rules: [On-topic] Posts must relate to qualitative research methods, practice, or theory.
[No commercial posts] Tool recommendations are OK in context; direct promotional posts are not.
selfPromoPolicy: [No commercial posts] Tool recommendations are OK in context; direct promotional posts are not.
